import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class SimpleNode {
        List<SimpleEdge> edges;

        public SimpleNode() {
            edges = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static class SimpleEdge {
        int trg;

        public SimpleEdge() {
        }

        public SimpleEdge(int trg) {
            this.trg = trg;
        }
    }

    static class WeightedEdge {
        int trg;
        int weight;

        public WeightedEdge() {
        }

        public WeightedEdge(int trg, int weight) {
            this.trg = trg;
            this.weight = weight;
        }
    }

    static class MCMFEdge {
        int trg;
        int cost;
        int adjcost;
        int flow;
        int cap;
        int dual;

        public MCMFEdge() {
        }

        public MCMFEdge(int trg, int cost, int cap, int dual) {
            this.trg = trg;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.adjcost = cost;
            this.flow = 0;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.dual = dual;
        }
    }

    static class GraphBase {
        List<SimpleNode> nodes;

        public GraphBase(int size) {
            nodes = new ArrayList<>(size);
        }

        public int size() {
            return nodes.size();
        }

        public int size(int id) {
            return nodes.get(id).edges.size();
        }

        public SimpleNode get(int id) {
            return nodes.get(id);
        }

        public void addEdge(int a, int b, int cost, int cap) {
            SimpleNode node = nodes.get(a);
            node.edges.add(new SimpleEdge(b));
            node = nodes.get(b);
            node.edges.add(new SimpleEdge(a));
            node.edges.get(node.edges.size() - 1).cost = -cost;
            node.edges.get(node.edges.size() - 1).cap = cap;
        }

        public void add(int a, int b, int cost, int cap) {
            addEdge(a, b, cost, cap);
        }
    }

    static class UGGraph extends GraphBase {
        public UGGraph(int size) {
            super(size);
        }

        public void add1(int a, int b) {
            addEdge(a, b, 0, 1);
        }

        public void add2(int a, int b) {
            add1(a, b);
            add1(b, a);
        }
    }

    static class MCMFGraph extends GraphBase {
        public MCMFGraph(int size) {
            super(size);
        }

        public void add(int a, int b, int cost, int cap) {
            addEdge(a, b, cost, cap);
        }

        public Pair make_flow(int source, int sink) {
            for (int i = 0; i < size(); i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < get(i).edges.size(); j++) {
                    SimpleEdge edge = get(i).edges.get(j);
                    edge.flow = 0;
                    edge.adjcost = edge.cost;
                }
            }

            int flow = 0;
            int cost = 0;
            while (true) {
                Pair up = augment(source, sink);
                if (up.first == 0) {
                    break;
                }
                flow += up.first;
                cost += up.second;
            }
            return new Pair(flow, cost);
        }

        public Pair augment(int source, int sink) {
            int N = size();
            int big = Integer.MAX_VALUE;

            int[] upby = new int[N];
            int[] prio = new int[N];
            int[] preve = new int[N];
            PriorityQueue<Pair> q = new PriorityQueue<>();

            prio[source] = 0;
            upby[source] = big;
            q.add(new Pair(source, 0));
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int cur = q.peek().first;
                int p = q.peek().second;
                q.poll();
                if (p != prio[cur]) {
                    continue;
                }
                for (int i = 0; i < get(cur).edges.size(); i++) {
                    SimpleEdge edge = get(cur).edges.get(i);
                    int p2 = p + edge.adjcost;
                    if (edge.flow < edge.cap && p2 < prio[edge.trg]) {
                        prio[edge.trg] = p2;
                        preve[edge.trg] = i;
                        upby[edge.trg] = Math.min(edge.cap - edge.flow, upby[cur]);
                        q.add(new Pair(edge.trg, p2));
                    }
                }
            }

            int up = upby[sink];
            int upcost = 0;
            if (up > 0) {
                int cur = sink;
                while (cur != source) {
                    SimpleEdge edge = get(cur).edges.get(preve[cur]);
                    SimpleEdge e = get(edge.trg).edges.get(edge.dual);
                    e.flow += up;
                    upcost += e.cost * up;
                    edge.flow -= up;
                    cur = edge.trg;
                }

                for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < get(i).edges.size(); j++) {
                        SimpleEdge edge = get(i).edges.get(j);
                        edge.adjcost += prio[i] - prio[edge.trg];
                    }
                }
            }
            return new Pair(up, upcost);
        }
    }

    static class Pair implements Comparable<Pair> {
        int first;
        int second;

        public Pair(int first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }

        public int compareTo(Pair o) {
            return Integer.compare(second, o.second);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int M = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int K = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int C = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int D = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int[] a = new int[K];
        int[] starts = new int[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            a[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            starts[a[i]]++;
        }

        int maxT = K + N + 1;
        int V = (maxT + 1) * N + 2;
        int src = V - 2;
        int sink = V - 1;
        MCMFGraph g = new MCMFGraph(V);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            if (starts[i] > 0) {
                g.add(src, i, 0, starts[i]);
            }
        }
        for (int t = 0; t <= maxT; t++) {
            g.add(t * N, sink, 0, K);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < maxT; t++) {
                g.add(t * N + i, (t + 1) * N + i, C, K);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int u = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            int v = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            for (int t = 0; t < maxT; t++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                    g.add(t * N + u, (t + 1) * N + v, C + (2 * j + 1) * D, 1);
                    g.add(t * N + v, (t + 1) * N + u, C + (2 * j + 1) * D, 1);
                }
            }
        }

        Pair fc = g.make_flow(src, sink);
        pw.println(fc.second);
        pw.close();
    }
